Because of its lower altitude, the weather here is somewhat less harsh, providing a place to rest, regroup, and re-equip.}} [[Yak's Bend]] is a village in the [[Northern Shiverpeaks]]. ==Getting there== Your character will arrive here after the completion of the [[Nolani Academy]] [[mission]]. Alternatively, you can run here from [[Ascalon City]] following [[:File:Ascalontolionsarch.jpg|this]] map. When running here, there is only one entrance directly south of the outpost, don't mistake it for the entrance of [[Shiverpeak Arena]]. ==Quests== ''All quests are available only for Tyrian ([[Prophecies]]) characters.'' *[[Captain Osric]] **[[The Way is Blocked]] {{Quest icon|Primary}} **[[The Road to Borlis Pass]] **[[Shiverpeak Stragglers]] *[[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]] **[[Helping the Dwarves]] *[[Howland the Elementalist]] **[[A Heart of Ice]] {{preq|e}} *[[Necromancer Morgan]] **[[Renegade Necromancer]] {{preq|n}} *[[Sebedoh the Mesmer]] **[[The Stone Summit Champion]] {{preq|me}} *[[Tabor Woolridge]] **[[The Missing Artisan]] *[[Van the Warrior]] **[[Securing the Vale]] {{preq|w}} **[[The Wayward Monk]] {{preq|mo}} ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{x}} 20 [[Captain Osric]] ([[skill trainer]]) *{{x}} 10 [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]] *{{x}} 2 [[Tabor Woolridge]] *{{w}} 20 [[Van the Warrior]] *{{n}} 2 [[Necromancer Morgan]] *{{me}} 2 [[Sebedoh the Mesmer]] *{{e}} 2 [[Howland the Elementalist]] ====Services==== *{{x}} 10 [[Sadira Powell]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Alpine Seed]]s) *{{x}} 1 [[Breyshaw]] ([[armorer]]) *{{x}} 2 [[Hylas]] ([[weaponsmith]]) *{{x}} 2 [[Sanura]] ([[merchant]]) *{{w}} 10 [[Bromgar]] ([[arena guard]]) ====Henchmen==== Henchmen are level 10 in {{reforgedmode}}. *{{w}} 8 [[Little Thom]] (Brawler) *{{w}} 8 [[Stefan]] (Fighter) *{{r}} 8 [[Reyna]] (Archer) *{{mo}} 8 [[Alesia]] (Healer) *{{n}} 8 [[Claude]] (Cultist) *{{me}} 8 [[Dunham]] (Enchanter) *{{e}} 8 [[Orion]] (Mage) ==Notes== *Complete exploration of this outpost contributes less than 0.1% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. ==Trivia== {{gw2w|Yak's Bend}} *This outpost is often referred to by players as "Yaks". *This outpost is named after [[Dolyak]]s, often shortened to "Yak." {{Towns and outposts in the Northern Shiverpeaks}}
